test_title: PYST 53: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends Anthony, Bunty, Giridhar, Rahul and Tarun are arranged in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order. Bunty sits at left end of the row. Only two people are sitting between Anthony and Giridhar. Anthony sits immediate next to the Bunty and Rahul sits second to the right of Bunty. Who sits between Rahul and Giridhar?
solution:
Given: Five friends Anthony, Bunty, Giridhar, Rahul and Tarun are arranged in a row facing north but not necessarily in the same order.

1) Bunty sits at left end of the row.

2) Anthony sits immediate next to the Bunty and Rahul sits second to the right of Bunty.

3) Only two people are sitting between Anthony and Giridhar. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/282b5a942e4f7815571ad15caea1c5173e9c33f93c4f05baa0a4a76f9b1e32dc.png] 

And, Tarun will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9ca067ba0f740e4dd7d5413e102373c86f081b9bc2aac7bf07981f84223c181.png] 

So, 'Tarun sits between Rahul and Giridhar.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
